texts.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的灵能的嗡声逐渐淡去，一瞬间万物寂静。[From.GetName]上的人群目瞪口呆（如果他们有眼和鼻的话），灵能射线从他们心智絮网中发散着，每个人都着迷于其强大和强烈的个人信仰。

如果他们之前不明白的话，现在他们知道了：我们都只是某个更伟大事物的一部分。
texts.en:
The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and personal truths the psionic ray unfetters from the tangled web of their minds.

If they did not understand before, they know now viscerally: we are all part of something greater.

tooltips.zh:
所有机械体，机械或蜂巢思维£pop£人口都被灵能共振摧毁。

所有残存的£pop£生物人口变成唯心主义。

向[This.GetName]添加神之光修正，持续10年：
唯心思潮吸引力：+999%。
tooltips.en:
Any Mechanical, Machine, or Hive-Minded £pop£ Pops are destroyed by the psionic resonance.

All remaining £pop£ Biological Pops become Spiritualist.

Adds the Divine Light modifier to [This.GetName] for 10 years:
Spiritualist Ethics Attraction: +999%.
